question: Does one bounded raw-scan segment from the camera-free density wedge associated with Apollo 16 magazine 111/J expose an integrity-clean Kodak 3401 Plus-X black-and-white response source for a later generic B&W interpretation pilot?

source.name: March to the Moon / NASA Johnson Space Center
source.source_description: The archive states that fixed-percent density wedges were placed directly on film without a camera. Segment 05 is the smallest advertised part of the five-part AS16-111 wedge.
source.scanner_description: Apollo film scans are described as Leica DSW700 scans at up to 200 pixels/mm and 14-bit A/D; exact member metadata remains to be audited.
source.rights_description: The source states that NASA/JSC raw scans of Apollo flight film are public domain; processed ASU derivatives are excluded.
source.allowed_use: bounded internal research and reproducible derived measurement from raw scan members only; no processed ASU product use

magazine_evidence.film_description: High Speed Black and White Plus-X, ASA 80-125
magazine_evidence.association_status: independently documented magazine association; archive contents must still match AS16-111 and remain raw-scan evidence

acquisition.reason_resume_forbidden: The same source endpoint ignored HTTP Range for the AS07-03 sibling on 2026-07-30.

forbidden_actions: fit any response before acquisition integrity and raw-scan identity pass
treat wedge percentages as scene RGB or a digital-photo pair
use this black-and-white source for SO-368 or any colour-stock response
claim scanner-independent response, calibrated sensitometry, developer identity or modern Plus-X equivalence
infer exposure spacing, illuminant spectrum, development parameters or density values absent from independent evidence
expand to the other four segments before segment 05 is adjudicated

branch_rule.source_pass: open a separately frozen black-and-white parsing and monotonic-response feasibility audit only
branch_rule.source_fail: close this segment without curve fitting and retain manufacturer priors plus generic physical-inspired B&W sensitometry

claim_ceiling: One historical Kodak 3401 Plus-X magazine-associated, camera-free density-wedge raw-scan segment source audit; not a digital-to-film pair, modern stock response, calibrated sensitometry, process truth, scanner independence or product promotion.
